outlook.title: Offshore of Southwestern Mexico
outlook.summary: An area of low pressure may develop well offshore of southwestern Mexico early next week. Gradual development is possible, and a tropical depression could form around the middle of next week while it moves west-northwestward at 10 to 15 mph, likely remaining well offshore of Mexico.
